versions.changes_summary: Rewritten for AlarmSpark: Apple Health and Health Connect (sleep sessions, on device only); weather from Open-Meteo using approximate location; sleep sound downloads from Cloudflare; backups are files you save where you choose (no Google sign-in); photo, barcode and motion missions processed on device; Firebase Crashlytics and Performance Monitoring added; the in-app "Share anonymous usage data" switch; RevenueCat reporting purchases to Google Analytics; legal bases, retention periods and Oman's Personal Data Protection Law; removed features that no longer exist.

Rewritten for AlarmSpark: current features, watch apps and shortcuts; corrected what is Free and what is Pro; payments are processed only by Apple or Google (RevenueCat manages subscription status); weather from Open-Meteo; backups are files you save; updated cancellation steps; reliability disclaimer covers permissions and watch connection; translations may be provided, English prevails.
